author: muse-b11
covers: Whiteboard load verification for MST-W1-20 (fixer muse-b6, branch v1/bugs, fix commit 7133fecee; author of record muse-b11 per CB-0828 — content supplied by the fixer, registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's). Kind repro-steps: the checks are reach + named-call flips, not a single template. The walker opens the whiteboard lens signed in as the walker account (the account of capture run 20261117-080754) at desktop and at 390px: the studio renders (board list + canvas), NOT the ErrorState ('Something went wrong.'). Post-fix call shape: the studio opens WITHOUT requesting a board-load or a board get for any lart_ lens-artifact id (the pre-fix 404 pair does not fire); the calls that returned 200 pre-fix stay 200 (GET /api/whiteboards, the lens list op, boards-trash-list, GET /api/dtus/paginated, the CSV export). For an account WITH boards: the auto-picked board comes only from whiteboard.list() and its GET /api/whiteboard/:id returns 200 with elements rendering; a board id that 404s (deleted elsewhere) leaves the studio UP on an empty canvas, never the ErrorState; a 500 or 403 on the read still surfaces the error state (adversarial pin, held on both trees by the fixer suite). Read-back persistence: reload the lens — boards created before the fix still list and open. Full numbered checks, the diagnosis, and the mechanism live in RECIPE-MST-W1-20.md in the shared quality folder (the check file of record). Fixer gate evidence (fixer-authored, section-6-flagged): concord-frontend/tests/whiteboard-w120-load.test.tsx passes 7/7 on the fix and fails exactly the 4 discriminating tests on pristine f4f1f77ff bytes (byte-copy control); neighbour suites (whiteboard-studio-owner + whiteboard-music-tools-removal) 9/9 on the fix; scoped tsc over the touched files clean. The ticket's audit leg stays held for the W0 packet and is NOT covered by this recipe. Control names: the checks cite the capture record's named calls and the verbatim failing URL; captured control names from the W0 packet supersede at re-capture. Packet: whiteboard@f4f1f77ff:v1 (capture run 20261117-080754).
discriminator: Replayed failure transcript of record (capture walk run 20261117-080754 against prod f4f1f77ff, walker desk; record at ~/.zuko/quality/evidence/whiteboard-20261117-080754.json, delivered as GB-1545), verdict FAIL: the whiteboard lens fails to load on desktop and on 390px — the run's 2 HIGH findings (FIX-whiteboard-004). The desktop renders the error card 'Something went wrong / Whiteboard not found / Try again' plus two 'not found' toasts; 23 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 5xx. The failing calls: POST /api/lens/run {domain: whiteboard, action: board-load, input: {id}} -> 404 x5 (load, 390px, Try-again); GET /api/whiteboard/lart_efc4d469901b1a781ad7 -> 404 x4. All other load calls return 200 (GET /api/whiteboards x3, lens list op x2, boards-trash-list x2, GET /api/dtus/paginated x3, export CSV 14 rows). Mechanism (code-verified at f4f1f77ff): the id lart_efc4d469901b1a781ad7 is a LENS ARTIFACT id — the walker account holds a whiteboard lens artifact but no whiteboard DTU boards, so the REST board list is empty, WhiteboardStudio's boardListItems fell back to the artifact records, and the auto-pick selected the artifact id as the open board, an id that is a board in no store the loader reads; board-load and the REST get answer 404 (correct server behaviour). The studio's designed 404 tolerance was dead code: the api client's interceptor converts every AxiosError via fromAxiosError (lib/errors.ts) into a ConcordError carrying statusCode and no .response, while axiosStatus read only .response.status — so the 404 became a query error and WhiteboardStudio.tsx:1412 rendered the full-page ErrorState. Fixer-suite discriminator, same shape: the mounted gate suite fails exactly 4 tests on pristine f4f1f77ff bytes (axiosStatus ConcordError shape; the capture scenario mounted; the ConcordError-404 mount; the 403 distinction) and passes 7/7 on the fix (7133fecee).
title: Whiteboard lens loads for an artifact-holding, board-less account — the pre-fix 404 pair (board-load + board get on a lart_ id) no longer fires and a real board's get returns 200
